Send_acknowledgment.emailMessage/Body:
Hello,

Thanks for applying to DriverAI. Your application has been received and is under review.

Reference number: @{outputs('AppRef')}

If you are selected, a member of our team will contact you to discuss next steps. You do not need to reply unless you are updating your resume. To do that, send a new or reply email to apply@driverai.io with the subject "Update - @{outputs('AppRef')}" and attach the new file.

Good luck on your next journey.

Warm regards,
The DriverAI Recruiting Team

This is an auto-generated email and this mailbox is not monitored.

Send_duplicate_notice.emailMessage/Subject: Your DriverAI Application Is Already On File (Ref: @{first(body('Filter_submitted'))?['Application ID']})
Send_duplicate_notice.emailMessage/Body:
Hello,

Your application is already on file with DriverAI and under review, so there's no need to resubmit.

@{if(greaterOrEquals(int(coalesce(first(body('Filter_submitted'))?['Application Updates'],'0')),2),'

This is our final automated reply regarding this application. If there is a match, a member of our team will contact you directly. You do not need to reply, and you are welcome to apply again after 90 days.

',concat('

If you are selected, a member of our team will contact you to discuss next steps. You do not need to reply unless you are updating your resume. To do that, send a new or reply email to apply@driverai.io with the subject "Update - ',first(body('Filter_submitted'))?['Application ID'],'" and attach the new file.

'))}

Good luck on your next journey.

Warm regards,
The DriverAI Recruiting Team
